title: Name Formatter
description:
```
Enter your full name: grace brewster hopper
First:    grace
Last:     hopper
Initials: G.B.H.     (stretch)
Formal:   Hopper, Grace
Length:   21 characters
Username: ghopper
```
hints: `rfind` is `find` searching backwards from the end, so `rfind(' ')` finds the last space; the last name starts one character after it: `full.substr(full.rfind(' ') + 1)`.
To capitalise a word, copy it into a `std::string` and change the first character: `word[0] = static_cast<char>(std::toupper(word[0]));`.
requirements: Functions taking `std::string_view` for the read-only helpers
Assume the name has exactly a first and last name (stretch: middle name too)
